# Claude Code Full-Stack Starter

> A reusable GitHub template that bootstraps a Claude Code project with five specialist AI subagents (architect, frontend, backend, QA, code reviewer), pre-configured workflows, coding standards, and architecture documentation — built specifically for full-stack TypeScript development with Anthropic's Claude Code CLI.

This template solves a common problem for developers using Claude Code: every new project requires manually setting up `CLAUDE.md`, defining subagents, writing workflow skills, and establishing coding standards. This template provides all of that as a one-click GitHub template.

## What it provides

- Five specialist subagents in `.claude/agents/`: architect (tech decisions, ADRs), frontend-specialist (React + TypeScript), backend-specialist (Node.js + Postgres + Zod), qa-engineer (tests + edge cases), code-reviewer (pre-merge audit)
- A `new-feature` skill in `.claude/skills/` that orchestrates the full agent workflow
- Pre-configured Claude Code permissions in `.claude/settings.json`
- Architecture, product, and ADR (Architecture Decision Record) documentation scaffolding
- TypeScript-strict coding standards enforced via `CLAUDE.md`

## Who it is for

- Solo developers and small teams using Claude Code for full-stack TypeScript work
- Engineering leads establishing AI development standards
- Consultants and agencies spinning up new client projects on a repeatable foundation

## How to use it

Click "Use this template" on the GitHub repository, or run:

```
gh repo create my-project --template rdhawladar/claude-code-fullstack-starter --private --clone
```

Then `cd` into the new project and run `claude`. Agents auto-load from `.claude/agents/`.

- [README](https://github.com/rdhawladar/claude-code-fullstack-starter/blob/main/README.md): Full overview, setup, FAQ

- [Product context template](https://github.com/rdhawladar/claude-code-fullstack-starter/blob/main/docs/product.md)
- [ADR template](https://github.com/rdhawladar/claude-code-fullstack-starter/blob/main/docs/decisions/0001-template.md)

## Subagents

- [Architect](https://github.com/rdhawladar/claude-code-fullstack-starter/blob/main/.claude/agents/architect.md): System design, tech selection, ADRs (uses Opus)
- [Frontend specialist](https://github.com/rdhawladar/claude-code-fullstack-starter/blob/main/.claude/agents/frontend-specialist.md): React + TypeScript, accessibility, browser testing (Sonnet)
- [Backend specialist](https://github.com/rdhawladar/claude-code-fullstack-starter/blob/main/.claude/agents/backend-specialist.md): APIs, DB, services, auth (Sonnet)
- [QA engineer](https://github.com/rdhawladar/claude-code-fullstack-starter/blob/main/.claude/agents/qa-engineer.md): Tests, edge cases, regressions (Sonnet)
- [Code reviewer](https://github.com/rdhawladar/claude-code-fullstack-starter/blob/main/.claude/agents/code-reviewer.md): Pre-merge audit (Opus)

## Skills

- [new-feature](https://github.com/rdhawladar/claude-code-fullstack-starter/blob/main/.claude/skills/new-feature/SKILL.md): End-to-end full-stack feature workflow
